headline: US and Canada Working on Deal to Ease Steel and Auto Tariffs
summary: The White House is lifting tariffs on certain Canadian goods, including machinery, as the US and Canada work on a broader agreement to ease steel and auto tariffs.
why: Cross-border tariffs directly affect supply chain costs and margins for manufacturing and automotive sectors in North America.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Easing tariffs on autos and steel could lower input costs for automakers operating in North America.
